filter: keep only pre-arrival trajectories of robots that finish in a collision-free episode; retain successful individual robots in timeout episodes; discard all samples from collision episodes
internal_holdout: whole training episodes with layout index modulo 5 equal to 0; never split adjacent frames
checkpoint_selection: first four frozen validation layouts: maximum team success then minimum capped completion then minimum internal holdout MSE
arrival_stop_note: same deterministic distance stop as Classical; no classical obstacle avoidance or safety filter during BC inference
